snapshot: Age and club checked October 6, 2026. Caps/goals: official October 5 pre-Canada preview. Camp inclusion is not a fitness certification.
intro: A current camp, a changing leadership group, and a longer horizon. Inspect the roles, compare the evidence, and keep the next four years in perspective.
standfirst: 28 players in the current camp. Four goalkeepers, ten defenders, nine midfielders and five forwards. Tonight’s lineup is still unannounced.
explorerIntro: Start with the current 28, or switch to a 2030 watchlist of emerging senior players and six youth-pathway names. The watchlist is editorial, not ranked. Official camp groups are preserved even where club roles differ. Clubs and ages are dated; caps and goals use the pre-Canada preview.

players.name: Chris Brady
facts: 22 years old on October 6. Listed in the official goalkeeper group for this camp.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Chicago Fire. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.
Chicago academy goalkeeper with substantial MLS starting experience and two senior U.S. caps in the October 5 snapshot.

analysis.strength: A pressured back-pass asks for a decision before the ball reaches the goalkeeper.
analysis.question: Where is his starting position as the defence steps up?
analysis.watch: Separate club starting experience from international experience.

players.name: Matt Freese
facts: 28 years old on October 6. Listed in the official goalkeeper group for this camp.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Philadelphia Union. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.
With 20 caps, he is the most capped goalkeeper in this camp. His federation profile documents three shootout saves against Costa Rica in the 2025 Gold Cup.

analysis.strength: A goalkeeper’s international experience is one part of the selection context.
analysis.question: What does his distribution show when the opponent removes the easy first pass?
analysis.watch: Judge build-up separately from shot-stopping and shootout pedigree; no guaranteed No. 1 status is asserted.

players.name: Diego Kochen
facts: 20 years old on October 6. Listed in the official goalkeeper group for this camp.
Barcelona confirms a loan to Lyngby until June 30, 2027, with a purchase option.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Weston. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: The goalkeeper can help choose where the first contest happens.
analysis.question: Short support, a switch, or a longer pass with teammates prepared to contest it?
analysis.watch: The first decision under pressure. Academy pedigree is not a distribution metric.

players.name: Brian Schwake
facts: 25 years old on October 6. Listed in the official goalkeeper group for this camp.
The September 23 federation feature records a 2025 Open Cup-winning run, 12 league clean sheets and a 0.81 goals-against average in its season snapshot.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Sockers. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: An additional senior option broadens the competition in goal.
analysis.question: What do his saves, box decisions and build-up each show?
analysis.watch: Separate those jobs: clean sheets also reflect the defence and opposition. He is a new senior option, not a teenage prospect.

players.name: George Campbell
facts: 25 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Atlanta United. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.
His return this window followed a January 2025 senior debut.

analysis.strength: A defender’s next pass can beat pressure or simply transfer it to a teammate.
analysis.question: Does the recipient have a usable next action?
analysis.watch: How quickly the defensive line resets after his pass. A low cap count alone does not establish playing level.

players.name: Sergiño Dest
facts: 25 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
An experienced right-back option at PSV, with 45 caps in the dated preview.

analysis.strength: Going outside, receiving inside and staying behind the attack create different relationships.
analysis.question: Which movement best complements the player ahead?
analysis.watch: The covering responsibility behind an advance; compare with Freeman without assuming a fixed depth chart.

players.name: Alex Freeman
facts: 22 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
His right-side combination with Gio Reyna helped create Hall’s Mexico opener.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Weston / Orlando City. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: Width and an inside receiver can create complementary options.
analysis.question: Who supplies width, and who moves inside?
analysis.watch: The coordination with the next receiver. One sequence does not establish a permanent partnership.

players.name: Peyton Miller
facts: 18 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
New England lists both defender and winger roles and records 50 MLS starts before his 19th birthday. Its latest profile snapshot lists seven league goals and four assists this season.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: New England Revolution. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A wide player’s advance can stretch a compact midfield.
analysis.question: Who protects the channel when he goes forward?
analysis.watch: The timing of the advance and the covering position. Attacking totals do not measure defensive reliability.

players.name: Neil Pierre
facts: 18 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
Philadelphia’s call-up announcement records four goals in 10 MLS appearances. His exact birth date and height are omitted because official sources conflict.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Philadelphia Union. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A centre-back may add set-piece threat while still carrying a separate defensive responsibility.
analysis.question: How does he decide between stepping forward and protecting the space behind?
analysis.watch: Assess set-piece movement separately from defending space.

players.name: Chris Richards
facts: 26 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
Richards and Trusty anchored the Mexico clean sheet.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: FC Dallas. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: One defender’s advance works with the other’s protection of depth.
analysis.question: If one steps into midfield, who covers the space behind?
analysis.watch: Judge the coordination across possessions; a single clean sheet is not a complete defensive grade.

players.name: Antonee Robinson
facts: 29 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
An experienced left-back at Fulham, with 61 caps in the dated preview.

analysis.strength: An overlap can give the winger an additional decision and stretch the next defender.
analysis.question: Does the overlap arrive at the right moment relative to the winger’s first touch?
analysis.watch: The cover behind him if the cross is blocked. Attacking ambition is only part of fullback evaluation.

players.name: Miles Robinson
facts: 29 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Boston Bolts. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.
The Cincinnati defender scored the winner in the 2021 Gold Cup final.

analysis.strength: A defender can contest a receiver or preserve depth; the choice changes the next duel.
analysis.question: When should he step, and when should he hold the line?
analysis.watch: At attacking set pieces, the first movement before the delivery. His role deserves more than a backup label.

players.name: Auston Trusty
facts: 28 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
Richards and Trusty anchored the Mexico clean sheet.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Philadelphia Union. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: One defender’s advance works with the other’s protection of depth.
analysis.question: If one steps into midfield, who covers the space behind?
analysis.watch: Judge the coordination across possessions; a single clean sheet is not a complete defensive grade.

players.name: Frankie Westfield
facts: 20 years old on October 6. Listed in the official defender group for this camp.
The federation’s September 23 feature records nine assists in 22 club matches, all starts.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Philadelphia Union. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A defender joining play can change the angle of the final delivery.
analysis.question: When is the early cross best, and when does another combination improve it?
analysis.watch: The choice before the cross; an assist count cannot describe every possession.

players.name: Tyler Adams
facts: 27 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
He is captain for the new cycle. Pochettino’s pre-Canada comments emphasize veteran-to-young-player learning and workload rotation.

analysis.strength: A midfield reference can help younger teammates understand when to move together.
analysis.question: What remains protected when the first player presses?
analysis.watch: The support behind pressure, as well as the visible ball-winning action.

players.name: Mathis Albert
facts: 17 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
Dortmund development coach Mathias Schiele highlights his willingness to isolate and beat defenders, then attack goal.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: LA Galaxy. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A one-against-one option can force a second defender to leave another job.
analysis.question: After attracting that second defender, when does the next pass arrive?
analysis.watch: The choice after the dribble, not only whether the first opponent is beaten.

players.name: Sebastian Berhalter
facts: 25 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
Pochettino describes flexibility across holding, box-to-box, attacking and wide midfield tasks. His first two window matches produced two goals and two assists.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Columbus Crew. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: Flexibility can connect phases without keeping the same on-paper position.
analysis.question: Does his job change when the team builds, attacks and loses the ball?
analysis.watch: The next supporting position after his first contribution.

players.name: Zavier Gozo
facts: 19 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
Official camp group: midfielder. His player profile says forward. The federation feature traces RSL, the 2025 U-20 World Cup, and six goals plus four assists before the Palace move.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Real Salt Lake. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A wide player can either stretch the touchline or attack the channel inside.
analysis.question: Which movement creates room for the next teammate?
analysis.watch: A transfer is a development step, not evidence of immediate starting status.

players.name: Adri Mehmeti
facts: 17 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
MLS analyst Joseph Lowery highlights his turning, passing range, movement to receive and defensive instincts. This is Lowery’s assessment.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Red Bull. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A receiving midfielder can connect the first line with players facing forward.
analysis.question: Can he receive beyond the press while leaving the centre protected after a turnover?
analysis.watch: His shoulder check, support angle and next action—not a speculative potential score.

players.name: Yunus Musah
facts: 23 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
The AC Milan midfielder is in his first U.S. window of 2026.

analysis.strength: Carrying past the first defender can open a pass that was not available before.
analysis.question: Where is the next supporting midfielder when he advances?
analysis.watch: Whether the progression connects to a useful next action.

players.name: Brooklyn Raines
facts: 21 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
New England’s September 17 release records 23 league starts this season and previous U-21 captaincy.

analysis.strength: Repeated responsibility offers development evidence beyond a goals tally.
analysis.question: Where is his support angle when the first pass enters midfield?
analysis.watch: His position after the ball moves wide, when the next central pass or turnover becomes possible.

players.name: Gio Reyna
facts: 23 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
His combination with Alex Freeman helped create Hall’s Mexico opener.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: NYCFC. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: An inside receiver can connect the wide route with the penalty area.
analysis.question: Does the first touch open the next forward action?
analysis.watch: His relationship with the wide player and forward, rather than an isolated touch count.

players.name: Malik Tillman
facts: 24 years old on October 6. Listed in the official midfielder group for this camp.
His late Mexico goal followed a takeaway.

analysis.strength: Pressure and regains can be attacking contributions before the final pass.
analysis.question: When is the moment to attack the ball rather than hold the shape?
analysis.watch: What happens immediately after a turnover, not only his positioning as a No. 10.

players.name: Cole Campbell
facts: 20 years old on October 6. Listed in the official forward group for this camp.
The September 23 feature traces Atlanta, professional football in Iceland at 15, Dortmund, and this summer’s move to Elversberg. He remains uncapped in the October 5 preview.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Atlanta United. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A new senior option may be asked to perform a narrower role than at club level.
analysis.question: What is his first senior job if selected?
analysis.watch: Zero caps is missing senior evidence, not proof of a low ceiling.

players.name: Damion Downs
facts: 22 years old on October 6. Listed in the official forward group for this camp.
Joined as the replacement for the injured Ricardo Pepi on September 20.
He is on loan to St. Louis from Southampton. His 2024–25 Köln promotion season produced ten goals and five assists.

analysis.strength: Pinning a centre-back and checking short create different spaces for teammates.
analysis.question: Which movement complements the next runner?
analysis.watch: Whether another attacker uses the space his movement releases.

players.name: Justin Ellis
facts: 19 years old on October 6. Listed in the official forward group for this camp.
Orlando’s September 17 release records double-digit MLS assists and his 2025 Generation adidas Cup MVP and Golden Boot. Exact current assist totals are not asserted here.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Orlando City. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A dropping forward can create a path for another runner.
analysis.question: Does he re-enter the box after helping the attack connect?
analysis.watch: The return movement after the first pass, not simply the assist.

players.name: Julian Hall
facts: 18 years old on October 6. Listed in the official forward group for this camp.
He scored in each of his first three senior appearances. The Mexico opener was a first-time finish around the six-yard area.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Red Bull. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: A box runner can turn a second ball into a finish before the defence resets.
analysis.question: Where does he move before the delivery, and after the first clearance?
analysis.watch: His position one action before the ball reaches him. Three caps do not establish a long-term striker ranking.

players.name: Cavan Sullivan
facts: 17 years old on October 6. Listed in the official forward group for this camp.
Philadelphia lists him as a midfielder; this camp lists him as a forward. His Mexico goal followed an interception of the goalkeeper’s pass.
Academy pathway noted by the federation: Philadelphia Union. This is one part of the development story, not a complete biography.

analysis.strength: An attacker can create danger by choosing the right passing lane to close.
analysis.question: When should he press the ball, and when should he hold the lane?
analysis.watch: His connection in settled possession after the immediate transition ends.

cycle.title: A place in camp is the beginning.
cycle.text: A senior call-up and a handful of caps are evidence of an opportunity, not proof that development is complete. Watch repeatable contributions across different game states.

cycle.title: Roles before a predicted XI.
cycle.text: A useful cycle watchlist asks who can solve a particular football problem. It leaves room for changing systems, club minutes, availability and late development.

cycle.title: Keep the World Cup team in its own chapter.
cycle.text: The archived 2026 roster preserves that tournament’s context. This notebook follows the next cycle without rewriting the summer.
